coverage_note: 44 product lines, 70 model names, 96 unique snapshots, 18 sourced manufacturers. Tavily hit its plan limit at the start and the shared WebSearch budget ran out mid-run, so Chinese/Korean/Indian makers beyond Cindbest and SEMISHARE, and Nextron product pages, were not enumerated. Some sources are third-party copies (Purdue-hosted Lake Shore datasheets, QD Europe, PSI, AKAM-hosted 3S datasheet) or facility/directory listings (BNL for MMR VTMP, IMS for CMPS-308-4K, eTesters for MDC 441); extraction should prefer manufacturer pages. LN2-only probe stages (Linkam, Instec) are included because they are sold as cryogenic probe stations; -60 C thermal-chuck probers (MPI, SEMISHARE C, Cindbest CT) are excluded.
